teaser: Ten in the morning, and the rental car idles in a parking lot while you check the route twice before pulling out. Life path 4 asks for structure built slow and kept honest; INFJ reads the room before it speaks. Crossed, you get someone who builds the long plan quietly and feels every crack in it before anyone else notices. The 4 wants the thing finished and sound. The INFJ in you wants it to mean something too. Most weeks those two needs sit in the same seat without complaint, but not always.
